description: Delta-neutral cash-and-carry: long spot + short perp, harvest funding. 3-symbol combo with regime exit filter.

liquidation_guard.note: Short perp leg: 2x leverage → ~50% adverse move approaches liquidation. Rebalance (move spot collateral to perp margin) when loss on perp leg exceeds 25% of position.

cost_model.note: Costs scale with leverage: at 2x, entry+exit = 60bp total.

regime_filter.note: 90 events ≈ 30 days. When trailing 30d funding sum < 0, close the position (stop paying); re-enter when it turns positive again.
